at the FUNNEL (§95E2: the engine's). 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST; `#if DEBUG` is off for players. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER.

# 96. WATER RENDER PARITY — **LAB BUILT (green), RUN PENDING — "does not match vanilla, rotated to go vertically"**

Field report (w17, screenshot): banded LAKE water renders as VERTICAL streaks, unlike vanilla. **History (ABWaterV2 banner, keep straight):** water-vanished-from-above FIXED (`SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` — 1.6 water is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE: visible `Map/TerrainWater` samples the WaterDepth subcamera RT at its own screen position; depth pass missing = no water); rivers/lakes anchored into the surface band (centres were rolled against full-stack z); river width clamped (0.22 × band height, producer-patched not def-patched); **`_MapSize` republish DISPROVED by A/B (vanilla publishes FULL STACK and that is CORRECT — but ⚠ that A/B ran on a surfaceBand=0 map where the fold is IDENTITY, and it bundled a REPEAT-wrapped folded flow texture with the Slot republish — two variables)**; ghost-river was the surviving theory and anchoring was expected to kill the symptom — **the field now says it did not (rule 17)**.

**96.a VANILLA PIPELINE (desk-verified):** `WaterInfo.SetTextures` runs EVERY FRAME from `Map.MapUpdate`; publishes `_WaterOutputTex` (WaterDepth subcamera RT), `_WaterReflectionTex`, `_MainCameraScreenParams`, `_MainCameraVP`, `_WaterOffsetTex` (map-sized RGFloat CLAMP texture, built ONCE from `riverFlowMap`, **pixels written ONLY where `BaseTerrainAt(c).IsRiver` at build time** — so a carved ghost river reaches the texture ONLY if the BASE grid still says river (rule 21); null when no river → shader default), `_MapSize` (full stack — correct per the A/B). `SectionLayer_Watergen : SectionLayer_Terrain` (internal) draws `waterDepthMaterial` (`Map/WaterDepth` shader per TerrainDef XML) into `SubcameraDefOf.WaterDepth.LayerId`. Shader also consumes `_WaterCastVectSun/Moon`. The compiled TerrainWater shader is not readable from here — hence the lab, not a theory.

**96.b THE LAB (`V2/ABDevTools.V2Water.cs`, dev-only, session-local, never scribed).** Overrides re-applied via postfix on `SetTextures` (vanilla republishes per frame — a one-shot would be overwritten; idle cost = two static bools). Actions under "As above": **(1) flow OFF (black)** — 1×1 RGFloat (0,0) into `_WaterOffsetTex`: kills every flow influence, texture AND uv-math; **(2) flow NORTH** — (0,1): calibrates the flow-driven-vertical fingerprint; **(3) depth OFF (black)** — ARGB32 clear into `_WaterOutputTex`: calibrates the dead-depth fingerprint; **(4) paint test pond** — 17-cell water blob at camera centre (deep core, shallow rim; gutter-skipped) so any band gets test water on demand; **(5) report+** — `ABWaterBand.Report` (incl. per-band water/depth-mat/**baseRiver** census, lakeCenter band, riverFlowMap/texture state, published `_MapSize`) + lab state + `_WaterOffsetTex` global (null = shader default) + WaterDepth subcamera sync deltas (pos/ortho vs main camera, RT size vs screen) + view band/level. Existing actions still live: "AB2: water report", "AB2: bisect - toggle below water depth" (`ABV2Debug.DrawBelowWater`, default TRUE).

**96.c DECISION TREE (fingerprints → mechanism):** vertical SURVIVES flow-black → flow fully exonerated in one move → compare against depth-black fingerprint (match = depth pass not reaching those cells → suspect subcamera sync / Watergen on banded maps / our §61 camera clamps vs `SubcameraDriver` update ORDER, rule 25's neighbourhood) → if neither matches, the residual suspects are `_MapSize`-fed wave math (re-open the disproof: it was identity-fold + two-variable) and `_WaterCastVectSun/Moon`. Vertical DIES under flow-black → ghost flow confirmed → check report+'s per-band `baseRiver` census for base-grid rivers under carved bands (rule 21) → fix = base-grid hygiene at carve time + one-shot repair for existing saves + `riverFlowTexture` rebuild. Flow-NORTH fingerprint ≈ the user's screenshot → same conclusion from the other side.

**96.d NOT YET DONE:** the fix itself (mechanism-named only after the run); a vanilla-reference run (multiLevel=false in the test savedata's `Mod_50b4332c2547_ABMod.xml`) if the user wants side-by-side; upstream check whether ANY water existed on the screenshot map's other bands (report+ census answers).
